shape_push_v1.responsibility: Learn a goal-conditioned short planar EE continuation at an established contact. Also expose a deterministic full-geometry initial-contact prior; this is not learned contact classification.
shape_push_v1.selection_cues: One selected rigid planar physical instance with an explicit local SE2 goal and visible support. Use the same interface for prepare and continuation, not letter-specific policies.
shape_push_v1.entry_conditions: Fresh consistent scene/calibration and live EE pose; semantic instance and layout resolved by visual Agent. Initial prepare additionally requires complete validated geometry. Continuation requires commissioned contact confirmation.
shape_push_v1.continuation_conditions: Fresh observation after each <=15mm/1s stroke, stable contact/height/orientation domain, no protected-object movement or guard violation, goal within local range. Reobserve rather than resume stale sequence.
shape_push_v1.exit_conditions: Proposed_prepare/proposed_continuation is a decision completion only. Missing input, stale scene, needs view/calibration/full geometry/local goal, no safe candidate, invalid goal/geometry or executor_replan are non-success exits. At-goal observation is not task success.
shape_push_v1.successor_readiness: Executor receives a bounded geometry objective and must validate full envelopes, table clearance, allowed actor contact, timing and commissioned guards. Agent receives feedback and independently measures pose/semantic task error.
shape_push_v1.switch_procedure: Cancel active ticket on interruption/guard/contact loss, withdraw/view through supplied planner, update scene, reset memory as needed, choose a new contact, actor or staging objective. No human per-move selection or recorded index script.
shape_push_v1.failure_signatures: Rigid-flow failure, incomplete topology for initialization, ambiguous identity/track, contact loss, neighbor movement, increasing goal error, stale observation, planner collision failure, controller guard or two distinct nonprogressing tickets.
shape_push_v1.memory_reset_rules: Reset on changed instance/reference gauge, goal, calibration, re-association or interruption. Network stateless. External memory stores only objective key, last failed ticket and retry count; optional0.2s motion history must be causal.
shape_push_v1.observation_dependencies: Visible support points and explicit current-to-goal SE2 transform, live T_base_ee/T_base_P, uncertainty, timestamp/revision. Optional frozen SAM2 automatic inventory is unvalidated geometry/identity proposals; visual Agent handles semantics and persistent assignment. Full geometry/tool support and controller commissioning required only for physical initialization/execution, not offline EE-delta supervision.
shape_push_v1.training_evidence: Only authorized A/B recordings. Expanded2Hz plus47 references, source-key deduplicated. Future RGB rigid motion defines numeric hindsight goals; direct recorded EE differences are targets. Original12groups kept for balancing, A train/B development. Actual coverage and quality in preparation reports, never assumed from candidate count.
shape_push_v1.limitations: Two same-inventory episodes, correlated windows; B not untouched. No force/contact truth, verified full actor annotations, autonomous semantic tracking, physical success or unseen-shape/word test. Initial-contact heuristic unvalidated physically. Broadly authorized flip egg has no supplied task/data in this package.
